en.role: Concept for Long-Term Socioeconomic Development Through 2020
en.quote: …R&D spending (private and public) [should reach] 3 percent of gross domestic product.
en.head: Research spending reached 1.09% of GDP in 2020.
en.body: Rosstat data analyzed by HSE put domestic research and development spending at 1.09% of GDP in 2020. The government concept set a 3% target for that year. Both figures measure the same share in the target year.
